name: URL cleaner
summary: Clean a URL: strip tracking from links
author: friday-core
description: Rewrites links for sharing and checking: removes tracking parameters (utm, fbclid, gclid and similar), unwraps known redirect wrappers (Google, Facebook, Outlook safelinks, Reddit, YouTube) and flags look-alike tricks: user@ in the address, punycode hosts, bare IP addresses, link shorteners, plain http. It only rewrites text; it never opens the link.
